VideoOverlay.PowerUp.Recall.Title: Recall
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.Recall.Description:
This power lets you turn back time to a period
when you were safe.

When in trouble, Press  {BD}  to launch
 the Recall power.
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.EyeOfTheStorm.Title: Eye of the Storm
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.EyeOfTheStorm.Descr:
This power slows down time for everything
except you. You gain a speed advantage
 for a few seconds.

Tap  {BD}  to turn it on, and tap  {BD}  again to
 turn it off.
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.RavagesOfTime.Title: Ravages of Time
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.RavagesOfTime.Descr:
This power lets you attack and quickly finish
 a fight with enemies.

While blocking with  {BE} , tap  {BD}  to launch the
Ravages of Time power.
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.BreathOfFate.Title: Breath of Fate
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.BreathOfFate.Descri:
This power lets you do a strong ground attack
hurting several enemies simultaneously.
Use this power when the Prince is
surrounded by enemies.

While blocking with  {BE} , Press and Hold  {BD}
to launch the Breath of Fate power.
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.WindOfFate.Title: Wind of Fate
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.WindOfFate.Descript:
This power lets you do a stronger ground
attack than the Breath of Fate Power.
Use this power when the Prince
 is surrounded by enemies.

While blocking with  {BE} , Press  {BD}  to launch 
Wind of Fate power. Press and Hold  {BD}
the longer for a stronger attack
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.CycloneOfFate.Title: Cyclone of Fate
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.CycloneOfFate.Descr:
This power lets you do the strongest ground
attack hurting several enemies
simultaneously. Use this power when the
Prince is surrounded by enemies.
 
While blocking with  {BE} , Press  {BD}  to launch
the Cyclone of Fate power. Press and hold  {BD} 
longer for a stronger attack.
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.SandTank.Title: new sand tank
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.SandTank.Descriptio:
A new sand tank lets you stock
more Sands of Time.
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.LifeUpgrade.Title: life upgrade
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.LifeUpgrade.Descrip:
As the health bar increases,
 the Prince becomes stronger.
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.SandWraith.Title: the Sand Wraith
VideoOverlay.PowerUp.SandWraith.Descript:
Sands of Time regenerate
but your life slowly fades away.
VideoOverlay.Weapon.SpiderSword.Title: Spider Sword
VideoOverlay.Weapon.SpiderSword.Descript:
This ancient sword is common 
on the island. 


Use it for a 3-Combo attack.
Press {BB}{BB}{BB} to perform the combo.
VideoOverlay.Weapon.SerpentSword.Title: Serpent Sword
VideoOverlay.Weapon.SerpentSword.Descrip:
This very special sword serves as a key 
and lets you perform 
a more powerful combo 


Press {BB}{BB}{BB}{BB} to perform the combo.
VideoOverlay.Weapon.LionSword.Title: Lion Sword
VideoOverlay.Weapon.LionSword.Descriptio:
This mystical sword lets you store 
 energy. Use it to unleash  
the energy for devastating attacks.


Hold {BB} until the attack is released.
VideoOverlay.Weapon.ScorpionSword.Title: Scorpion Sword
VideoOverlay.Weapon.ScorpionSword.Descri:
This sword is stronger than walls.


Hold {BB} near a cracked wall to destroy it.
VideoOverlay.Weapon.WaterSword.Title: Water Sword
VideoOverlay.Weapon.WaterSword.Descripti:
This sword is not well-known.
According to legend, it has 
more power than imaginable.
VideoOverlay.Weapon.EagleSword.Title: Eagle sword
VideoOverlay.Weapon.EagleSword.Descripti:
A noble and powerfull blade,
fit for a Prince.


Use it for a 3-Combo attack.
VideoOverlay.Weapon.WoodenStick.Title: Wooden stick
VideoOverlay.Weapon.WoodenStick.Descript:
This sturdy wooden stick is a weak
replacement weapon.


It can only chain 2-combo attacks.
